leadText: Transform! Hero of the Seas, Palafin (Japanese: 変身！海のヒーローイルカマン Transform! The Hero of the Sea, !) is the 42nd episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,274th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on March 8, 2024, in the United Kingdom on September 9, 2024, in Australia on September 27, 2024, in sub-Saharan Africa on October 8, 2024, and in the United States on November 22, 2024.
plainText:
Transform! Hero of the Seas, Palafin (Japanese: 変身！海のヒーローイルカマン Transform! The Hero of the Sea, !) is the 42nd episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series, and the 1,274th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on March 8, 2024, in the United Kingdom on September 9, 2024, in Australia on September 27, 2024, in sub-Saharan Africa on October 8, 2024, and in the United States on November 22, 2024.
 

==Blurb==
 
 The Rising Volt Tacklers are visiting an ocean beach, but most of the adults are busy with errands or chores, so Liko and Roy go exploring as Ludlow watches. Suddenly, a man nearby almost falls from a rooftop, but he’s saved by Palafin, a heroic Pokémon who is able to transform and become more powerful in a pinch. No one has ever actually seen Palafin transform, and a trio of young photographers is determined to get a photo of it happening, but Liko realizes that Palafin probably wants to keep it a secret. And when trouble strikes again, Palafin faces a dilemma… 

==Plot==
Having finally arrived back in Paldea, 
Liko and Roy learn about convergent species.
Ludlow is revealed to have a superhero alter ego called "Mighty G" and own a .
Friede is informed of the existence of a mysterious tower.

==Trivia==
Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar: What powers does gain when it transforms?
Choices: Flight, super strength, jet propulsion
Answer: All of the above
The first eyecatch features Roy and his , and the second features Ludlow and his .
For the initial airing of this episode, Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar was replaced by an announcement about the collaboration between Pokémon GO and Pokémon Horizons: The Series, which included a bonus scene featuring Professor Willow. This scene was cut from the VOD versions, but was uploaded to the official Pokémon YouTube channel. 
This episode marks the first time that a human character introduced in Pokémon GO appears in the .
When first appears, Liko asks if it is a boat or a submarine, which seems to be a reference to the iconic quote from 1940's : "It's a bird! It's a plane! It's Superman!"
This occurs again when Roy and one of the Snap Boys spot "Mighty G" emerging from the sea, with them respectively asking if it is a boat or a ship.
This is the second episode of Pokémon Horizons: The Series to have its n dub released before the English dub, being released on August 30, 2024. 

===Errors===

===Dub edits===
After Liko ends the recap saying "The Rising Volt Tacklers are heading to Paldea", in the Japanese version, Roy says "We're here!" after arriving on the beach, thus implying the Rising Volt Tacklers have reached Paldea. In the English dub, Roy instead says "A day at the beach!".
Liko trying to guess the emerging Palafin's identity changes the mention of a yacht to a submarine in the English dub. Likewise, Roy and one of the Snap Boys' guesses on the Mighty G's identity are changed from a yacht and a boat to a boat and a ship in the English dub.
The bonus scene featuring Professor Willow was excluded from all non-Japanese dubs.
